Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.inbound

Interface CompareVendorsUseCase

All Known Implementing Classes:
ResearchOrchestratorService
public interface CompareVendorsUseCase
Inbound port — compare AI vendors for a given healthcare query and return a structured result containing per-vendor assessments and the source citations used during evaluation.

Two modes are supported:

  • Free-form query — the COMBINED retrieval pipeline discovers vendors from the retrieved sources (original behavior).
  • Vendor-select — the caller provides explicit vendor topic names and articles are fetched directly per vendor, bypassing query decomposition.

Unlike ConductResearchUseCase, this port does not persist a ResearchRun record — vendor comparisons are transient UI operations.

  • Method Details

    • compare

      VendorCompareResult compare(String query, int maxSources, int minVendors, String scoring)
      Run the vendor comparison pipeline for a free-form query.
      Parameters:
      query - The healthcare AI research question; must not be blank.
      maxSources - Maximum number of source documents to retrieve; must be ≥ 1.
      minVendors - Minimum number of vendor sections to request from the AI; must be ≥ 1.
      scoring - Scoring algorithm: "TF_IDF" or "DOC_FREQUENCY" (default).
      Returns:
      A VendorCompareResult containing vendors sorted by relevance descending and the deduplicated source citations evaluated.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if query is blank or maxSources < 1.

    • compareSelected

      VendorCompareResult compareSelected(List<String> vendorTopics, String focusArea, int maxSources, String scoring)
      Run the vendor comparison pipeline for explicitly selected vendor topics.

      Articles are fetched directly per vendor topic name (e.g. "Anthropic Healthcare"), bypassing query decomposition and relevance filtering. An optional focusArea narrows the AI comparison to a specific healthcare domain.

      Parameters:
      vendorTopics - Non-empty list of vendor topic names matching feed config topics.
      focusArea - Optional healthcare focus area (e.g. "radiology"); may be null or blank.
      maxSources - Maximum source documents per vendor topic; must be ≥ 1.
      scoring - Scoring algorithm: "TF_IDF" or "DOC_FREQUENCY".
      Returns:
      A VendorCompareResult containing vendors sorted by relevance descending.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if vendorTopics is empty or maxSources < 1.
